info.name: Accusharp HRMS - Full Walkthrough
info.description:
One complete payroll cycle for one employee (EMP005, Priya Kulkarni, September 2026).

RUN THE FOLDERS IN ORDER 00 -> 08. Between folder 02 and 03 you must load the punch SQL into device_logs - there is no API for punches.

Set the `baseUrl` variable if the app is not on http://localhost:8080.

Only POST/PUT/PATCH need a header, and only ever `Content-Type: application/json`. There is no authentication.

item.name: 00 - Look around
item.description: Read-only. Note the ids you get back - you need them when creating an employee.

request.description: The salary breakup is calculated when an employee is saved. Change these percentages before adding people, not after.
HR001=HR, SUP001=SUPERVISOR, EMP001/EMP002=EMPLOYEE.

item.name: 01 - Set up master data
item.description: Create the designation, the employee and the month's holiday.

request.description: Note the returned id - pass it as designationId next.

userId MUST equal the biometric device's user_id.
You send 4 money fields; basicDA / hra / conveyance / education / grossSalaryWage come back derived and cannot be sent.
Mandatory holidays are removed from working days so they can never become LOP.

item.name: 02 - Roster the month
item.description: Without this there are no expected working days and the whole month becomes LOP.

item.name: Bulk assign MORNING shift, Sundays off

request.description: Returns 29 rows: 30 days - 1 holiday. Four of them are flagged weekOff. Leaves 25 working days.

item.name: 03 - Attendance BEFORE leave
item.description: Run the punch SQL first! See docs/testing/device_logs_EMP005_2026-09.sql

request.description:
Expect workingDays 25, presentDays 22, absentDays 3, lopDays 3, overtimeHours 3.5, invalidPunches 0.
All three absences are unpaid right now because the leave is not approved yet.
The 17th shows 11.5 worked hours and 3.5 overtime.

item.name: 04 - Leave workflow
item.description: Employee applies -> supervisor endorses -> HR approves. Only the last step moves balance.

request.description: Quotas are seeded on first read: casual 12, sick 8.
Saves the returned id into the leaveId variable for the next two requests.
Status becomes SUPERVISOR_APPROVED. Balance has NOT moved yet.
Only HR or ADMIN may do this. THIS is the step that consumes balance and offsets LOP.

item.name: 05 - Attendance AFTER approval
item.description: The same call as folder 03 - watch LOP fall from 3 to 1.

request.description: leaveDays is now 2 and lopDays is 1 - only the 29th, where no leave was applied for.

item.name: 06 - Payroll
item.description: You supply only the manual amounts; everything else is derived.

request.description: payableDays 24 (25 working - 1 LOP). netSalary 18936.20.
A period is generated once. Use regenerate to correct it.
Writes revision 2 and marks revision 1 SUPERSEDED - the old figure is never overwritten.
rev 2 GENERATED net 19086.20, rev 1 SUPERSEDED net 18936.20.
Skips anyone already generated. Uses zero for all manual deductions.
Open in a browser and print or save as PDF.

item.name: 08 - Error cases worth seeing
item.description: Every failure returns the same ApiError shape.

request.description: Every field failure is listed in one message.
'Supervisor SUP001 does not manage employee HR001'
Final approval needs the HR or ADMIN role.
An open or approved leave already covers part of this range.
